## Publish green-light checklist (per package)

1. `stage: stable` -- conformance suite green on the pinned compiler, recorded with `run_by`, `commit`, `passed`/`failed` (`scripts/port.ps1` + `scripts/status.ps1 -Action update`).
2. Package name listed in `.github/publish-allowlist.txt`.
3. Registry scope enumerated for the dotted name (registry session).
4. CI gates ready: `registry-publish` environment (repo protection decision) and the `XIOM_SIGNING_KEY` secret for a stable first-party signature.
5. First publish is a canary (`workflow_dispatch` with `package=<name>`, staging registry) followed by an install-back check.
6. Production enablement only after the staging canary verifies.

Versions are immutable forever; a published version can never be replaced.
